Sam (eng-runtime): quick postmortem from the staging canary on admit behavior — 10:30 run
Lee (infra): got the traces? saw something odd in kernel handoff
Sam (eng-runtime): yup attached logs, but TL;DR: under a 35% incoming spike we saw steady growth in queue wait time and sudden 429 clusters when token budget hit the per-lane cap
Nina (mlperf): per-lane cap? which lane split did you use for the run
Sam (eng-runtime): 60/30/10 latency/throughput/kvcache lanes. We left preemptive-shed disabled, only soft-reject path enabled
Rahul (sre): how long were the 429 bursts and which routes hit it
Sam (eng-runtime): bursts lasted ~14s, affected text-generation high-context routes (seq_len 1024). Route ids: gen-text-v2, chat-beam-3
Lee (infra): can you paste the admission metrics snapshot
Sam (eng-runtime): metrics snippet:
```
admit.total_requests=12.4k
admit.soft_rejects=420
admit.hard_429s=120
admit.kv_hit_rate=0.48
batch.avg_size=6.2
token_budget.used=0.98
```
Nina (mlperf): kv_hit_rate under 0.5. that explains kernel mismatch overheads on long tails
Sam (eng-runtime): exactly — KV misses plus big seq lengths force slow L2 kernel, batch sizes drop, token budget drains faster than refill
Rahul (sre): idea: staged preemptive shedding where lanes have probation windows. i.e. when lane token_bucket < X, start probabilistic defer for new requests for Y ms before full 429
Lee (infra): we already have a probation flag for microbatch preempt, but it's global not lane-aware
Sam (eng-runtime): proposal sketch:
- keep current token lanes
- add lane_probatation_ms per lane (default 200ms)
- add prob_shed_rate ramp: when token_bucket<0.8 -> 5% shed, <0.6 -> 15%, <0.4 -> 40%
- when kv_miss_rate>0.3 amplify shed_rate by +10pct
Nina (mlperf): that amplification makes sense — misses cause kernel slowdowns and are correlated with queueing
Rahul (sre): need to avoid oscillation. add hysteresis: once a lane enters probation, freeze shed_rate for min_hold_ms (e.g. 1s) unless token_bucket recovers >0.95
Sam (eng-runtime): yes min_hold_ms=1000 seems reasonable. Also add a max_consecutive_probations counter to avoid starving lanes
Lee (infra): what about metrics and tracing changes? want per-lane shed counter, probation_count, and recent_kv_miss_rate per lane
Sam (eng-runtime): will emit these, also plan to add a small debug tag on blocked requests: "admit=prob_shed(v=0.15)" so we can trace in X-Ray
Rahul (sre): run length of probe in staging? suggested timeline: enable on 1 rack -> 2 hours -> validate latency p50/p95 + 429 count and rollout
Sam (eng-runtime): agreed. add canary failure criteria: >+5% p95 latency or >+50 hard_429s per 10min window compared to baseline -> rollback
Nina (mlperf): small note: adjust quant profiles for gen-text-v2 to prefer fast-gemm kernel at shorter prefixes; reduces need for shedding
Lee (infra): one more safety: fallback to forced-429 after retry_limit if request keeps being deferred >3x to avoid head-of-line bloat
Sam (eng-runtime): implemented locally; I'll push PR with flag defaults and a staging run config
ops-bot: deploy-job queued: runtime/admit-probe-v1 -> staging (run-id 2026-03-18T16:05)
Rahul (sre): nice. after the run let's check per-lane tail latencies and kernel-switch counts
Sam (eng-runtime): will share logs + graphs here. thanks all :thumbsup:
Lee (infra): also add a small synthetic load that injects kv misses to validate amplification path
Sam (eng-runtime): good call, adding that to the run plan
Nina (mlperf): if results look good we should include this in the release notes under "admission control improvements"
Sam (eng-runtime): filing the RFC draft tonight, will tag you all for review
